checks.check: T-N remains the only net-repair contrast.
T-G0 is described only as a same-surface output contrast, not a pure operation effect when G0-N is nonzero.
G is explicitly a mechanism-misaligned stress comparator, not a benign or representative generic assistant.
G0 is a same-surface no-op placebo and portfolio summaries are not transported into stratum-level neutrality claims.
EIA is consistently a post-hoc compatibility probe, not prospective cross-domain confirmation.
Rsurf is an exact-output forced-one-answer integration-surface control, not an independent temporal retriever.
The +/-10pp threshold is identified as prospectively frozen materiality; no preregistered variance-based power rationale is invented.
Post-review power planning is explicitly future-design sensitivity only and cannot upgrade the completed Rsurf result.
All 18 Rsurf endpoint residuals and the two opposite-signed non-tie patterns are exposed from frozen existing data.
Full-task conjunctive-score sensitivity is reported as a different estimand: grounding unchanged; cutoff/alignment collapse due added orthogonal/exact-form requirements.
Minimal causal S/O/Y bookkeeping is explicitly not claimed as full SCM or mediation identification.
Multi-turn surface isolation is future design only; no current multi-turn callable-state claim is made.
A benign generic-helper arm is kept as an unexecuted future treatment and is not inferred from G or G0.
Small-n, ceiling-heavy, non-ceiling unresolved, Kimi grounding downgrade, and TimeSage exact-replication debt remain visible.
R15 introduces no new scientific execution, model call, provider call, threshold change, endpoint selection, or outcome-driven rerun.
